core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mizanur is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Balance of the Merciful”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mizanur corresponds to the Arabic form ميزان الرحمن (Arabic مِيزَانُ الرَّحْمَن (Mīzān al-Raḥmān)). Its core sense is mizanur; balance of the merciful. Mizanur is Arabic مِيزَانُ الرَّحْمَن (Mīzān al-Raḥmān) 'balance of the Merciful', a compound of مِيزَان (mīzān, 'balance') and الرَّحْمَن (al-Raḥmān). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ميزانور (a different form); the correct form is مِيزَانُ الرَّحْمَن. The source gloss 'Balance, Scales' is broadly consistent.
